title.zh: 将莱特省帕洛市镇马利龙村更名为利伯塔德村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Malirong, Municipality of Palo, Province of Leyte, to Libertad
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Malirong, Municipality of Palo, Province of Leyte, to Libertad
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Malirong, Thị trấn Palo, Tỉnh Leyte thành Libertad
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Malirong, เทศบาล Palo, จังหวัด Leyte เป็น Libertad
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Malirong, Kotamadya Palo, Provinsi Leyte menjadi Libertad
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Malirong, Perbandaran Palo, Wilayah Leyte menjadi Libertad

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1740_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the barrio of Malirong, Municipality of Palo, Province of Leyte, is changed to Libertad.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
